brief: 6 viral content formats every creator should steal.

slots.title: The Listicle Hook
slots.body: People love bite-sized value. Break down tips into numbered slides and watch your saves explode. It's the easiest format to batch.

slots.title: Storytime Threads
slots.body: Open with a wild first line. Build tension, then drop the lesson. Your audience stays for the plot, not the advice.

slots.title: POV Storytelling
slots.body: Put viewers directly in the scene. POV triggers instant empathy and stops the scroll. It beats generic tips every time.

slots.title: Micro Tutorials
slots.body: Teach one thing in under a minute. Use big text and simple steps. Saves go crazy when the takeaway is instant.

slots.title: Spicy Hot Takes
slots.body: Challenge a common belief in your niche. A spicy opinion sparks comments and debates. Just make sure you back it up.

slots.title: Behind The Scenes
slots.body: Show messy drafts and your failed ideas. Authenticity always wins over perfection. People follow humans, not highlight reels.

slots.headline: Steal One Format Today
slots.body: Pick a format and post it before midnight. Your next viral hit is one carousel away.
